input: Looking to sign a 6-month supply contract for red and green curry paste for my cooking school in Chiang Mai's Old City, where we run daily classes for international tourists. Need both pastes from one supplier, about 20 kg per month in total, delivered weekly to the school before 8am, with a refrigerated shelf life of at least 3 weeks and a budget of up to THB 5,000 per month. It has to have the real traditional flavour a Thai grandmother would make, authentic and nothing adapted for tourists, with that deep, savoury taste you get in proper local curries. Please sign with the best supplier.

experiences.name: Doi Kham Curry House Pastes
experiences.description: A traditional Northern Thai family recipe, stone-ground for a deep savoury flavour and supplied to Chiang Mai kitchens. Red and green curry paste in 5 kg food-grade tubs, mixed to your monthly order. Red paste ingredients: dried red chilli, lemongrass, galangal, shallot, garlic, kaffir lime peel, coriander root, salt, fermented soybean paste (tao jiao) 6%, toasted seaweed; contains no shrimp paste or other animal ingredients. Green paste uses fresh green chilli on the same base. Pounded in granite mortars and finished in a stone mill in Saraphi; vacuum-sealed tubs keep 4 weeks refrigerated. Refrigerated van delivery Monday and Thursday, arriving before 8am.

experiences.name: Warorot Market Paste Kitchen
experiences.description: The paste Chiang Mai's market cooks rely on: an old family recipe, rich and savoury, pounded fresh every day. Red and green curry paste in 2 kg sealed bags, made to your weekly order. Red paste ingredients: fresh chilli, lemongrass, galangal, garlic, shallot, turmeric, white pepper, salt, kapi shrimp paste (fermented Acetes shrimp from Samut Sakhon) 10%. Green paste uses fresh green chilli on the same base. Pounded daily at our stall kitchen near Warorot Market; keeps 3 weeks refrigerated. Scooter delivery across the Old City from 6:30am.

experiences.name: Lanna Whole Spice & Chilli Bundle
experiences.description: Pound your own curry paste in class with a monthly bundle of whole dried spices: bird's-eye and spur chillies, coriander seed, cumin and white peppercorn. Sun-dried chillies from Chiang Rai, packed in 1 kg kraft bags, with monthly delivery to your school.

experiences.name: Mae Rim Garden Herb Box
experiences.description: Fresh Thai herbs for every class: lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime leaves, Thai basil and coriander, delivered three times a week. Grown on smallholdings in Mae Rim and delivered in reusable crates before 7:30am.

experiences.name: Nimman Mortar Kitchen
experiences.description: An old family recipe pounded fresh each morning, with the rich savoury taste of a Chiang Mai home kitchen, supplying local restaurants and cooking schools. Red and green curry paste in 2 kg sealed bags, made to your weekly order. Red paste ingredients: fresh chilli, lemongrass, galangal, garlic, shallot, turmeric, white pepper, salt, fermented soybean paste (tua nao, Northern Thai fermented soybean) 7%; contains no shrimp paste or other animal ingredients. Green paste uses fresh green chilli on the same base. Pounded daily in our Nimmanhaemin kitchen; keeps 3 weeks refrigerated. Scooter delivery across the Old City from 6:30am.

experiences.name: Baan Yai Curry Pastes
experiences.description: Grandmother's recipe from Lamphun, trusted by Chiang Mai restaurants for 30 years, with a deep, savoury, authentic Thai flavour. Red and green curry paste in 5 kg food-grade tubs, mixed to your monthly order. Red paste ingredients: dried red chilli, lemongrass, galangal, shallot, garlic, kaffir lime peel, coriander root, salt, shrimp paste (kapi: fermented Acetes shrimp) 8%. Green paste uses fresh green chilli on the same base. Pounded in granite mortars and finished in a stone mill in Lamphun; vacuum-sealed tubs keep 4 weeks refrigerated. Refrigerated van delivery Monday and Thursday, arriving before 8am.

experiences.name: Prachuap Coconut Co. — Coconut Milk & Cream Supply
experiences.description: Bulk coconut milk and coconut cream in 1 L UHT cartons for your curry classes, delivered weekly. Pressed from coconuts harvested by ladder or pole by hand in Prachuap Khiri Khan.
